en-US.description: An open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Autodesk AutoCAD, rebuilt in pure Rust
en-US.longDescription:
CADCraft is a fast, open-source, clean-room reimplementation of the AutoCAD workflow, rebuilt in pure Rust: the command line, object snaps, layers, dimensions, hatches, blocks and DXF drawings you already know. It runs natively on macOS, Windows, Linux and FreeBSD, and in the browser via WebAssembly.

What works today
- Command line: keyword prompts, history, AutoComplete, aliases, @dx,dy and @d<a entry, direct distance entry, transparent commands and .scr-style scripts.
- Draw and modify: LINE, PLINE, CIRCLE, ARC, RECTANG, POLYGON, ELLIPSE, SPLINE, XLINE, RAY, DONUT, TEXT and MTEXT, plus ERASE, MOVE, COPY, ROTATE, SCALE, MIRROR, STRETCH, OFFSET, TRIM, EXTEND, FILLET, CHAMFER, BREAK, JOIN, EXPLODE, rectangular and polar ARRAY, draw order and OVERKILL.
- Precision: object snaps (endpoint, midpoint, center, quadrant, intersection, perpendicular, tangent and more), polar tracking, ortho and grid snap.
- Layers and properties: Layer Properties Manager with on/off, freeze, lock and plot states, layer tools, and a Properties palette with per-object editing, linetypes, lineweights and true colour.
- Annotation: all DIM* commands with full DIMSTYLE variables and associative dimensions, MLEADER, TABLE, TrueType fonts, MTEXT formatting codes and a single-stroke drafting font.
- Hatch and blocks: pick-point hatch boundaries with islands, pattern, solid and gradient fills, BLOCK/INSERT, attributes and nested blocks.
- Files and plotting: DXF read/write (R12-2018), DWG read/write (R13-2018), PDF plotting, SVG and PNG export, paper-space layouts, viewports, page setups and PLOT.
- Parametric: geometric and dimensional constraints, AUTOCONSTRAIN, PARAMETERS with expressions and hot grips.
- Automation: an MCP server, a JSON control channel and the cadcraft-cli tool.

- i18n(ar): translate 129 new strings, use the catalog's terms in 3 by @SoldierPePe in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2564

- fix(io): a layout keeps its limits and paper image origin through a save (#2109) by @austin62jake in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2623
- fix(io): the paper viewport a save adds is the sheet at the layout's plot scale (#2108) by @austin62jake in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2624

- fix(io): read drawings with many groups in linear time (#862) by @whaslbeck in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2645
- DWG save keeps OLE objects (OLE2FRAME): stop reporting them as not saved by @johndoecesko in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2582
- fix(fonts): single-line TEXT runs left to right, as AutoCAD lays it out (#2500) by @austin62jake in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2618
- Remember the main window's size, position and maximized state between sessions (#2595) by @Elarionus in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2604
- Reject invalid fill angles in JSON arraypolar by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2655
- Reject control characters in layer names by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2569
- SVG import: a transform on a shape element moves the shape by @ashokram-si in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2602
- Dynamic blocks: a point on a frame edge of any length is on it by @2ez4gcx in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2640
- plot and exportpdf help name the device parameter (#2557) by @SoldierPePe in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2567
- The IME double-click test passes without craft-fonts by @Tyler-Chiriboga in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2652
- i18n(zh): translate the 74 strings the report listed as missing by @rahul05ranjan in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2638
- WBLOCK: new handles start above those of the copied blocks (#1996) by @tanish2k09 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2659
- EXPORT and WBLOCK say what a DWG file leaves out (#2240) by @tanish2k09 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2660
- Write option prompts without "or", as AutoCAD does by @2ez4gcx in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2540
- Say "or" once in prompts that offer options by @2ez4gcx in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2563
- AREA, PERIMETER and DISTANCE system variables, as AutoCAD sets them by @2ez4gcx in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2552
- i18n(pt-BR): translate the rows the sibling catalogs cover by @RicSchonfelder in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2581
- OVERKILL: objects within the tolerance are duplicates wherever their numbers fall by @Tyler-Chiriboga in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2653
- DXF: leave SAT-text solids out of 2013+ files, and ask before a save does (#2474) by @tanish2k09 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2661
- DXF: leave SAT-text solids out of 2013+ files, with a save note (part of #2334) by @SBaksa in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2474
- Plot style and plotter files save atomically (#1978) by @tanish2k09 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2662
- Plot style and plotter files save atomically (#1928 follow-up) by @MrBeeboh in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/1978
- fix(dwg): preserve MTEXT caret-adjacent whitespace (#2250) by @Zaxaerith in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2314
- fix(io): a moved DIMENSION draws its block at its insertion point (group 12) (#2634) by @rahul05ranjan in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2636
- DWG: scale actions keep the byte AutoCAD reads after their connections (acadrust 0.6.6) by @codyvogt in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/1725
- Xrefs: find a saved path regardless of letter case by @MrBeeboh in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/1982
- Persist current table style (CTABLESTYLE) in DXF header by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2117
- render: a display list past the block-expansion budget says what it left out by @midasmatterhorn in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/1278
- CLI: info and convert report what a damaged DWG left out (read notes, #859) by @STE1200 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2337
- DWG: a table cell's text height is an override only when the file flags it (part of #2501) by @SBaksa in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2588
- Saves to a missing folder write the file and say which folder was created (#2260) by @tanish2k09 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2668
- engine: save, render and export create a missing target folder instead of failing with os error 3 by @midasmatterhorn in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2260
- Save: a folder that can't be made says so, not that the backup failed by @tanish2k09 in https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft/pull/2669

zh-CN.description: 用纯 Rust 全新重写的开源净室实现，还原了 AutoCAD 的工作流
zh-CN.longDescription:
CADCraft 是一个用纯 Rust 全新重写的开源净室实现，还原了 AutoCAD 的工作流：你熟悉的命令行、对象捕捉、图层、标注、填充、图块和 DXF 图纸。它可在 macOS、Windows、Linux 和 FreeBSD 上原生运行，也可通过 WebAssembly 在浏览器中运行。

当前可用功能
- 命令行：关键字提示、历史记录、自动补全、别名、@dx,dy 与 @d<a 坐标输入、直接距离输入、透明命令和 .scr 风格脚本。
- 绘图与修改：LINE、PLINE、CIRCLE、ARC、RECTANG、POLYGON、ELLIPSE、SPLINE、XLINE、RAY、DONUT、TEXT、MTEXT，以及 ERASE、MOVE、COPY、ROTATE、SCALE、MIRROR、STRETCH、OFFSET、TRIM、EXTEND、FILLET、CHAMFER、BREAK、JOIN、EXPLODE、矩形/环形 ARRAY、绘图顺序和 OVERKILL。
- 精确绘图：对象捕捉（端点、中点、圆心、象限点、交点、垂足、切点等）、极轴追踪、正交和栅格捕捉。
- 图层与特性：图层特性管理器（开/关、冻结、锁定、打印），图层工具，以及支持逐对象编辑、线型、线宽和真彩色的特性选项板。
- 标注：全部 DIM* 命令，完整的 DIMSTYLE 变量和关联标注，MLEADER、TABLE、TrueType 字体、MTEXT 格式代码和单线制图字体。
- 填充与图块：拾取点填充边界与孤岛，图案、实体和渐变填充，BLOCK/INSERT、属性和嵌套图块。
- 文件与打印：DXF 读写（R12-2018）、DWG 读写（R13-2018）、PDF 打印、SVG 和 PNG 导出，图纸空间布局、视口、页面设置和 PLOT。
- 参数化：几何约束与标注约束、AUTOCONSTRAIN、支持表达式的 PARAMETERS 和热夹点。
- 自动化：MCP 服务器、JSON 控制通道和 cadcraft-cli 工具。
